name: TBETS-seg-hybrid (tbets-segmented's phase genomes on heterogeneous MCTS's per-gene tree)
description: tbets-segmented's greedy genomes and one-gene mutations (with repair) of phase genomes, stored in heterogeneous-mcts's tree of atomic actions: genomes that share their first genes share those edges, so UCB1 and the statistics are per gene, not per genome.
